exact_result: Leading colour exchange outside a singlet is the empty form; the first retained two-boundary order is (1/2)^2=1/4 and returns 1/4 to 1/2 to One in two Folds; every positive mediator has finite normalized range 1/m and m1<m2 forces 1/m1>1/m2.
falsification_condition: The claim fails if neutral leading closure or quarter order changes, reciprocal ordering fails, the complete pion and vector ranges overlap, either scattering interval ceases to be positive, channel dependence is erased, one-quarter is relabelled as a measured strength, or target access precedes sealing.
